text:
maya: quick check-in on the postmortem follow-ups from last week's GPU saturation incident. want to confirm owners/timelines for quota request, scheduler tuning, and headroom alerts/runbook.

dan: i have the scheduler tuning work in a branch (wip). aiming to land perf tests by EOD thurs. will post perf numbers and the PR link when ready.

sofia: i'm owning the quota increase with cloud infra. opened ticket to cloud-team (CCA-4321), they asked for peak graphs and a business justification. i'll share the doc by monday.

ben: set up a temp Grafana alert for node headroom < 25% and a CPU-side indicator. it's noisy atm, we should tune thresholds after dan's scheduler changes. :eyes:

maya: thanks. can we also attach an owner for the headroom runbook (playbook steps for mitigation + who pages)?

alex: i'll draft the runbook. plan: mitigation steps, rollback to smaller batch sizes, fallback to cheaper model variants, and emergency capacity request template. will share this PR by Tue. :thumbsup:

dan: quick snippet of the scheduler tweak I'm testing (WIP):
```
# increase preemption headroom and lower burst factor
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  preempt_threshold: "0.22"
  burst_factor: "0.6"
```
will run cluster perf job after landing.

sofia: cloud-team asked for a clear timeline. propose: quota request submitted Mon, review Wed, approved Fri (if no blockers). is that ok?

maya: yes that's fine. please add a short one-paragraph justification to the ticket: expected sustained QPS, peak token throughput, and business impacts if not approved.

ben: also creating a daily quick-check dashboard for the next 2 weeks (owner: ben). it'll show headroom, preemptions, and queue length. link to dashboard in ticket when ready.

infra-bot: Incident #2026-03-GPUSAT summary: root cause = scheduler headroom config + quota exhaustion; mitigations applied = temporary throttles, manual node increase; next steps assigned to owners. (link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-gpusat)

maya: action items recap: dan -> land scheduler PR (EOD Thu), sofia -> submit quota request + justification (Mon), alex -> runbook draft (Tue), ben -> dashboard + alert tuning (start today). we'll meet Fri 10am to verify metrics and close items or extend. if anyone needs earlier sync ping here.

sofia: ack, i'll add owners/timelines to the ticket and cc cloud-team.

dan: ack. will tag PR with performance numbers and link to the perf job.

alex: ack, will open runbook PR and request review from oncall.

maya: thanks all. setting a recurring 2-week review for incident patterns until we see 4 consecutive weeks of stability. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
